title: File observation in the canonical observation.v1 envelope
description: Register observation.schema.json by its $id (cernity.observation.v1) when resolving this schema. File attributes, including first_seen and last_seen, live in fields.file. The canonical ts and source_ref remain mandatory and unchanged. scan_verdict is a rule-stamped scan result, permitted only with available bytes; an empty matched_rules array means no matches, not a safety verdict.
